title: Auto build-artifact GC on low disk
intent: Draft PR #4416 handed off; settling execution
summary: Low-disk automatic build-artifact reclaim implemented: the daemon Issue Monitor scan calls worktree::gc::maybe_spawn with the disk_space warning thresholds ([build_artifact_gc] in config.toml, auto on by default), runs worktree.gc_build_artifacts with the dry-run default exclusions on a background thread, and appends each run to build-artifact-gc.jsonl surfaced as issue.monitor.status build_artifact_gc. Draft PR #4416.
progress_summary: Done: implementation, 8 new tests (RED proven), merged develop, fmt/clippy/gwt-config/rustdoc gates pass, Draft PR #4416, closure comment on #4391. CI adjudicates the full --all-features suite.
